product_wide_rationale: Backlog storage is a Product-wide boundary. Git holds active work and never holds a planning backlog: a Product's backlog lives in its confirmed Linear destination or in Concord's store, and a foreign session records other-Product work under the owning Product's scope.
summary: Prohibits committing any planning backlog into a git repository. A local-only Product keeps Concord planning authority, and a foreign session records other-Product work under the owning Product's scope instead of the superseded todo.md commit route. GitHub Issues is not a backlog destination.
title: Backlog never resides in git
